_comment: Core / pack-defining mods that must never be persisted or honored as a
learned crashes-server skip. A false positive here does not degrade a pack,
it bricks it: quarantining EnderIO on MC Eternal made GasConduits throw
MissingModsException and took the whole install down.

Matching is by lowercase modId (separator-insensitive, so one entry covers
both 'cofhcore' and 'cofh_core'), plus a filename match for ids of 5+
characters — short ids like 'ae2' or 'ic2' are modId-only so they cannot
"filenameMatch": false marks an entry as modId-only regardless of length.
Loader/runtime cores need this: 'forge' as a filename token matched EVERY
protecting most of a Forge pack from ever being quarantined.
max_entries is enforced by tests/verdict_store.test.js. Growing past it is a
decision to make deliberately, not a drift to discover later: each addition
is a mod the boot loop can no longer quarantine, so a genuinely broken jar
in this list becomes an install that fails with no remediation available.
